verdict.rationale: SavvyCal offers a documented REST API (OAuth-authenticated, with OpenAPI 3.0 spec confirmed at runtime) covering scheduling links, events, webhooks, and time zones, which could technically serve as a tool-calling surface for agents, but there is no MCP server, no llms.txt, and no explicit agent/tool-calling framing anywhere in the docs. missing for 10: an official MCP server, explicit agent-integration docs, and confirmation that the API surface covers availability/booking/event-type operations end-to-end for autonomous agent use.
